name: claude-code-vibe-mods
description: Small Claude Code mods that run beside the chat and cost no tokens.

plugins.name: announcer
plugins.description: A game announcer's call when Claude finishes a task, and a sound for what it does on the way (asks, commits, pushes, fails a test).

plugins.name: breathe
plugins.description: A short breathing exercise beside the chat: /breathe, on a schedule, or when your prompts run hot.
